Customer Onboarding — [Product/Service]

Slide 1 — Welcome & Objectives
- Purpose of onboarding and expected outcomes
- Top 3 business benefits for the customer
- Key contacts and roles (customer + vendor)

Slide 2 — Onboarding Timeline & Milestones
- High-level phases: Kickoff → Setup → Validation → Go‑Live
- Estimated timeframe and major milestone dates
- Acceptance checkpoints and deliverables

Slide 3 — Implementation Plan & Responsibilities
- Customer responsibilities (data, access, internal stakeholders)
- Vendor responsibilities (configuration, testing, handoff)
- Risk/issue owners and mitigation steps

Slide 4 — Training & Resources
- Training format and schedule (live sessions, recordings)
- Documentation, knowledge base, and sandbox access
- Recommended internal roles for training adoption

Slide 5 — Support, Communication & Escalation
- Primary support channels and SLA expectations
- Regular cadence: status meetings, progress reports
- Escalation path and executive contacts

Slide 6 — Launch, Adoption & Next Steps
- Go‑live checklist and success criteria
- Early adoption plan and KPIs to measure success
- Immediate next actions and assigned owners

Would you like speaker notes or a printable slide deck based on this outline?
